name: zarchive_list_find_node_by_payload
description: zArchiveList::FindNodeByPayload scans the circular archive list from head and returns the first node whose payload pointer matches the requested payload, or null when absent.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage checks a middle-node hit after tail appends and later absence through RemovePayload.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x48cb00 validate the null-list and empty-list returns, circular head-first traversal, payload pointer comparison, wraparound null return, and __fastcall ECX=list EDX=payload ABI.
The native smoke verifies that the middle payload is found at head->next after push-back insertion, then exercises removal paths that depend on the same lookup contract.
